prompts.Good: Minimal impact. Safe for all outdoor activities and exercise.
prompts.Satisfactory: Minor breathing discomfort to sensitive people.
prompts.Moderate: Breathing discomfort to people with lung disease, children, and older adults.
prompts.Poor: Breathing discomfort to most people on prolonged exposure.
prompts.Very Poor: Respiratory illness on prolonged exposure. Significant outdoor risks.
prompts.Severe: Affects healthy people and seriously impacts those with existing diseases.

aqi.officialNote: Calculated with official Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) linear interpolation.
